verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents pausing compute and resuming the same sandbox with the whole writable root filesystem preserved, plus auto_resume on inbound access. Memory state can also be kept by opting in with `memory: true`, and pricing lists retained memory as a billed storage item. Missing for 10: memory pause/resume is marked experimental and covers only 'supported' process state, filesystem preservation is tied to successful checkpoints, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
